newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore lunch shares weak, economy boost awaited.
newsitem.headline: Singapore lunch shares weak, economy boost awaited.

text.p: Singapore shares were mainly weaker at Monday's lunch break with investors yet to be convinced of a strong turnaround in the economy, dealers said.

"This is a classic case of a lot of people talking the same positive story but not being prepared to put their money in until we get another set of good economic numbers," a dealer at one foreign institution said.
"The signs are there, it's just a matter of time," another dealer said.
At 0430 GMT the Straits Times Industrials Index was off 6.67 at 1,974.29 with most other Singapore share indices falling too.
Blue chip stocks were the worst hit with foreign tranches of DBS and OCBC banks down at Singapore $19.80 and S$15.20 respectively.
Electronic counter Creative Technology took the biggest fall, falling S$0.60 to S$33.90, mainly in reaction to the launch last week of new multi-media software from competitor Venture Manufacturing.
Venture's early morning surge to S$8.00 was exhausted by lunch. The stock settled back to S$6.90 -- a gain of S$0.05 for the morning on volume of 4.1 million shares.
Interest was high in electronics shares, the sector expected to underpin the Singapore economy's second half resurgence, with small cap electronics stocks among the morning's active.
Total market volume for the morning was a robust 133 million shares, although losers headed gainers 188 to 143.
